title: InvoiceExtractionSchemaV1
description: Structured-output schema passed to Gemini as response_json_schema, matching domain.value_objects.ocr_result.OCRResult/OCRLineItem field-for-field. Numeric values are emitted as strings (not JSON numbers) to preserve exact decimal precision through json.loads()+Decimal() rather than round-tripping through float. Every property is required so the model must explicitly emit null instead of omitting a field it could not read confidently -- omission and 'confidently absent' must not be conflated.

raw_invoice_number.description: Invoice number exactly as printed -- never reformatted, never invented.

raw_prescription_classification_text.description: Verbatim text indicating prescription vs. over-the-counter status, if present on the invoice (e.g. 'Thuoc ke don'). Do not classify or normalize -- Domain does that from this raw text.

anyOf.description: Decimal string, e.g. '1234567.00'. Extracted as printed -- never recalculated.
Decimal string. Extracted as printed -- never recalculated, never inferred.

raw_commercial_discount_amount.description: The whole-invoice commercial discount/rebate ('CKTM', 'Chiet khau thuong mai', 'Giam tru...'), ONLY when the invoice prints it as its own summary row (not tied to any one medicine). Extract the PRE-TAX amount from that row's own 'Thanh tien'/Amount column (same meaning as a line's raw_line_total) -- never the tax-inclusive figure some suppliers also print in parentheses next to it, and never null-guessed from a totals mismatch. Null when the invoice has no such row.

lines.description: One entry per medicine line item on the invoice, in reading order. Every line the invoice shows must appear here -- never omit a line and never invent one that is not on the invoice.

raw_batch_number.description: Preserved exactly as printed, only leading/trailing whitespace trimmed -- never reformatted.

raw_unit_text.description: Unit exactly as printed (e.g. 'vien', 'tuyp', 'hop') -- Domain normalizes this, not the model.

anyOf.description: Decimal string. Extracted as printed -- never recalculated.

raw_retail_units_per_purchase_unit.description: How many Vien (retail tablets) make up one purchase unit, ONLY when the invoice text states this completely enough to compute a definite count (e.g. 'Hop 10 vi x 10 vien' = 100). Null whenever absent or incomplete (e.g. '(1 vi)' alone) -- never a guessed typical value.

anyOf.description: Decimal string, e.g. '5.00'. Extracted as printed -- never computed, inferred, or defaulted.

raw_vat_percentage.description: This line's VAT/tax percentage, ONLY when the invoice prints a VAT value/column for it. Null when absent -- never guessed.

overall_confidence.description: Overall confidence for the whole extraction, 0.00-1.00.

field_confidences.description: Per-area confidence, 0.00-1.00, per TS-002 Sec. 10 (Invoice, Supplier, Medicine, Batch, Totals).
